computed.meaning: xrp_flow is the day-over-day change in issuer-reported XRP holdings.
computed.feature_use: May be considered only as a holdings-delta feature after all row, fund, time and receipt checks pass.
computed.semantic_warning: Not an authorized-participant cash creation/redemption record and not a direct measure of investor cash.

initial.meaning: The fund's first observed row is its starting balance, not a flow.
initial.feature_use: Never use as a flow observation.

excluded.meaning: Flow is withheld because the holdings series has a known capture gap.
excluded.feature_use: Never coerce to zero and never use as a flow observation.

settled.meaning: Final row for the trading date.
settled.feature_use: Eligible for further validation, not automatically model-eligible.

provisional.meaning: Latest trading-day row may be rewritten by next-morning issuer re-settlement.
provisional.feature_use: Raw-only until superseded by a settled row; preserve the original vintage.

reconstructed.meaning: Holdings rebuilt from third-party daily flow estimates between issuer-reported anchor days; the day-by-day split is an estimate.
reconstructed.feature_use: Raw-only; never use as an observed per-day issuer holding or flow.

rounding.source_rule: Changes smaller than 100 XRP are treated as rounding noise and set to zero.
rounding.feature_rule: Preserve the raw reported value and a source_rounding_applied flag; do not silently replace the source value.

timestamps.data_as_of: Latest settled dataset row, not the retrieval timestamp.
timestamps.issuer_publication_time: Must be retained per issuer file where available.
timestamps.captured_at: Must be recorded by Barrot when raw bytes are fetched.
timestamps.first_seen_at: Must be recorded separately from issuer publication and effective trading date.
timestamps.rule: Do not backdate known_at to the trading date or treat overnight publication as same-day knowledge.

GXRP.holdings: Included in holdings and AUM totals.
GXRP.flow_status: Excluded across the history because automated reads of the issuer page were blocked during 2026-09-02 through 2026-09-28.
GXRP.incident: Holdings were frozen during the capture gap and a catch-up landed on 2026-09-28; booking the catch-up as one day's flow would misstate the day and trend.
GXRP.admission: Holdings and flow features require a separate source-vintage reconstruction; never interpret the excluded flow as zero.

XRPR.structure: 1940 Act fund with part of its XRP exposure held through other exchange-traded products.
XRPR.limitation: Its issuer file states only directly held coins; direct holdings are neither complete look-through holdings nor a reliable full-exposure flow measure.
XRPR.admission: Do not include in a pure direct-spot ETF aggregate without separately verified look-through exposure.

BITW.structure: Multi-asset Bitwise 10 Crypto Index Fund; only its XRP sleeve is included.
BITW.limitation: XRP sleeve holdings can move through index rebalancing; the publisher counts those holdings changes as flow.
BITW.admission: Keep as a separate index-sleeve feature, not in the pure spot XRP ETF flow aggregate.

admit_flow_row_only_if: fund ticker has an explicit product classification
issuer effective date, publication time, capture time and first-seen time are retained separately
raw source bytes are present and match the SHA-256 receipt
the issuer file passes its stated holdings/share/NAV reconciliation checks
the row is not a reconstructed, provisional, initial or excluded observation
never_do: Never map initial or excluded flow_status to numeric zero.
Never admit provisional or reconstructed rows as observed daily features.
Never combine BITW index-sleeve movements with pure spot ETF flows.
Never use XRPR direct-only holdings as complete look-through exposure.
Never label holdings deltas as AP cash flows or actual capital without AP/custodian evidence.
Never overwrite an earlier provisional vintage; append a settled revision with its availability time.

source_methodology_notes: XRP Insights states current flows are computed from issuer-reported holdings and no third-party flow feed is used for its current dataset.
A holdings change caused by anything other than creations/redemptions, including BITW index rebalancing and fees paid in XRP, is counted as flow.
Issuer files are published overnight to the next morning; the latest row can be provisional and later re-settled.

The dataset contains reconstructed historical ranges: 2026-03-23 through 2026-03-27; 2026-03-31 through 2026-04-29; and 2026-05-12. Those day-by-day splits are estimates from third-party daily flow estimates between issuer-reported anchors.
The source's aggregate net_flow_xrp sums computed per-fund flows; initial and excluded rows contribute nothing. A missing/excluded fund therefore must not be interpreted as an observed zero.

source_independence.current_dataset: XRP Insights says it computes current flows from issuer pages without a third-party flow feed.
source_independence.primary_source_status: The issuer holdings pages are the underlying primary sources, but this capture did not preserve their exact bytes.
source_independence.independence_rule: Do not count the aggregate and its per-fund rows as independent sources; they are one derived dataset from shared issuer inputs.

predictive_admission.reason: This artifact records a source methodology and admission contract, not byte-complete source data. The live collector still retains the XRP Insights endpoint raw-only; a row-level ETF parser and point-in-time vintage admission layer have not been implemented.

next_evidence_requirements: Capture original issuer holdings files byte-for-byte with SHA-256 and first-seen timestamps.
Reconcile issuer shares, XRP-per-share, NAV, net assets and holdings wherever published.
Capture the exact raw XRP Insights JSON and verify its generated_at/data_as_of metadata.
Build a row-level parser that preserves flow_status, row_status, ticker, product type and all timestamp vintages.
Obtain authorized-participant cash/coin creation-redemption and custodian settlement evidence before measuring actual institutional cash flow.
